items.subject: An elderly Spanish migrant woman in her early 50s, stocky build, dark cardigan and plain skirt, small among rows of simple headstones
items.action: standing still before a modest grave in a long row of former Wittenoom workers and residents
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, head bowed toward the headstone, shoulders drawn inward
items.setting: Suburban Perth cemetery in 1989, neat lawn rows of granite and concrete headstones stretching away under eucalyptus trees
items.color_palette: Faded green lawn, pale grey stone, dusty ochre paths, soft washed-out blue sky
items.props_detail: A small bunch of wilting native wildflowers laid on a plain granite headstone
items.camera_angle: eye-level from behind, rows receding toward the horizon
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon overcast daylight, long gentle shadows
items.mood: Still air, endless rows of stones in muted light, a lone figure motionless among them
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y nueve ya habían muerto más de quinientos antiguos trabajadores y residentes de Wittenoom.

items.subject: Former Wittenoom miners and residents, Spanish, Italian and Anglo-Australian men and women in their 40s to 60s, thin and weathered, in 1979 short-sleeved shirts and cardigans
items.action: gathering on folding chairs for the first meeting of a victims' society, a few leaning in to listen
items.gaze_interaction: most seen from behind facing a trestle table at the front; one gaunt grey-haired Spanish man in his 50s turns his head, hunched with a hand on his chest
items.setting: Modest community hall in Perth, 1979, timber floor, fibro walls, a trestle table at the front
items.color_palette: Worn honey timber, beige fibro walls, faded browns and mustard 1970s fabrics, dusty window light
items.props_detail: A tin cash box and a handwritten sign-up ledger on the trestle table
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the back of the hall
items.lighting: soft afternoon daylight through high louvred windows
items.mood: Quiet hall, stooped shoulders and laboured posture of the seated, warm diffuse light settling over them
items.narration_anchor: Los que seguían vivos se habían juntado diez años antes en la Asbestos Diseases Society of Australia.

items.subject: An Anglo-Australian judge in his 60s in horsehair wig and black robe at a raised timber bench, a gallery of elderly former miners and widows seen from behind
items.action: reading the verdict aloud from a sheaf of typed pages
items.gaze_interaction: judge's eyes down on the pages; gallery figures sit upright and motionless, a widow's head lifted toward the bench
items.setting: Wood-panelled Supreme Court courtroom in Perth, 1988, high ceiling, coat of arms above the bench
items.color_palette: Deep jarrah wood browns, black robes, cream walls, muted greys of 1980s suits
items.props_detail: The judge's bound sheaf of typed judgment pages
items.camera_angle: eye-level from the rear of the public gallery
items.lighting: soft daylight from tall side windows mixing with warm ceiling lamps
items.mood: Hushed room, a long shaft of pale window light across rows of still, stooped backs
items.narration_anchor: En mil novecientos ochenta y ocho un juez leyó su veredicto: la compañía había mostrado un desprecio continuo, consciente y contumaz por la seguridad y la salud de sus trabajadores.

items.subject: A Spanish-born woman in her mid-60s, slight build, grey-streaked dark hair, in a plain hospital gown, who grew up in Wittenoom
items.action: lying on the narrow table as it slides into the ring of a CT scanner
items.gaze_interaction: eyes turned up to the ceiling, arms resting at her sides, body still
items.setting: Quiet hospital imaging room in Perth, pale walls, beige scanner gantry centered in the room
items.color_palette: Clinical off-white, pale beige, soft grey, faint cool blue
items.props_detail: The beige scanner gantry ring receiving her
items.lighting: soft diffuse daylight from a frosted window, gentle and even
items.mood: Calm sterile hush, a small figure inside a large pale room, slow controlled breathing
items.narration_anchor: Mercedes de Juan, que se quedó en Australia, entra en un escáner y después sopla en un tubo.

items.subject: The same Spanish-born woman in her mid-60s, slight build, grey-streaked dark hair, in a simple cardigan
items.action: blowing hard into the tube of a spirometer during a lung function test
items.gaze_interaction: seen in profile, cheeks puffed, shoulders lifted with effort, eyes fixed ahead on the wall
items.setting: Small respiratory clinic room, plain desk, wall chart, window onto a Perth street
items.color_palette: Soft cream walls, pale wood, muted lavender cardigan, gentle daylight tones
items.props_detail: A cardboard mouthpiece tube connected to a boxy spirometer on the desk
items.lighting: soft diffuse window light, same calm clinic light as the scan
items.mood: Quiet effort, chest straining, a slight forward lean, calm daylight holding the room
items.narration_anchor: «Nos hacen un escáner y una prueba de función pulmonar», dice Mercedes.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings on red Pilbara earth
items.action: loose fibres lifting faintly in a light breeze, catching the sun
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction low across the ground toward the backlit fibres
items.setting: Ground surface of the abandoned Wittenoom townsite, red dust and scattered stones
items.color_palette: Rust red earth, ochre, dusty grey, faint steel blue of the fibres
items.props_detail: A single fine strand of fibre drifting just above the ground
items.lens_technique: macro lens, shallow depth of field
items.lighting: low golden-hour backlight rimming the fibres
items.mood: Silent, delicate glinting threads in warm air, nothing moving but the drift
items.narration_anchor: Las fibras pueden causar mesotelioma, asbestosis y cáncer de pulmón.

items.subject: A government records room lined with metal shelving of manila case files
items.action: the tallied files end abruptly, the last shelves standing half empty
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction down the aisle toward the empty shelves at the far end
items.setting: Windowless state archive storeroom in Perth, grey metal shelves, linoleum floor
items.color_palette: Grey steel, faded manila, dusty cream, pale institutional green
items.props_detail: A final file box left unlabelled on an otherwise bare shelf
items.lighting: soft pale light from a single high window, dust in the air
items.mood: Still, dusty silence, rows ending in bare metal under weak light
items.narration_anchor: La cuenta oficial se detuvo. «El gobierno dejó de contar en 2.000, pero ahora se calcula que la cifra puede ser superior a los 4.000.

items.subject: An Anglo-Australian man in his late 50s, thin, sun-lined face, son of a former Wittenoom police officer, in a faded checked shirt
items.action: sitting alone in a hospital waiting area, holding a faded 1960s school class photograph on his knee
items.gaze_interaction: head lowered toward the photograph, shoulders slumped, breathing shallow
items.setting: Hospital respiratory ward waiting area in Perth, row of plastic chairs, pale corridor
items.color_palette: Pale institutional green, beige, faded sepia of the old photograph, soft grey
items.props_detail: A creased black-and-white school photograph of Wittenoom children in front of a corrugated iron schoolhouse
items.lighting: soft diffuse daylight from a corridor window
items.mood: Quiet corridor, a stooped seated figure, gentle light on a faded image
items.narration_anchor: Y sigue aumentando», dice Melita Markey. Están enfermando hijos de policías y de maestros que trabajaron en el pueblo.

items.subject: Wittenoom ghost town
items.action: lying deserted and half-demolished in the red desert, wind moving dust across empty streets
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction down onto the sparse grid of remaining buildings and bare lots
items.setting: Hamersley Range foothills, Pilbara, the abandoned townsite in its later decaying state
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey iron, hints of blue tailings, clear dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: Bare concrete slabs where demolished houses once stood
items.lens_technique: deep depth of field, wide-angle aerial
items.lighting: soft late-afternoon light, long shadows from the ranges
items.mood: Vast silence, empty roads under open sky, dust drifting over vacant lots
items.narration_anchor: Mientras los enfermos se contaban a sí mismos, el Estado decidió qué hacer con el pueblo: borrarlo.

items.subject: A highway road sign at a desert turnoff and a lone Anglo-Australian road worker in his 40s, lean, in a sun-faded work shirt and wide-brim hat
items.action: unbolting and removing the town name panel from the sign, leaving a blank rectangle
items.gaze_interaction: worker seen from behind on a short ladder, facing the sign
items.setting: Pilbara highway junction in June 2007, red gravel shoulder, spinifex, distant ranges
items.color_palette: Red earth, faded green and white sign metal, spinifex gold, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: The detached name panel leaning face-down against the sign post
items.mood: Empty highway, a small figure against a huge sky, the blank sign facing nothing
items.narration_anchor: Junio de dos mil siete; otras fuentes dicen dos mil seis. Wittenoom es abolido formalmente. Le quitan el nombre a las señales de la carretera y lo sacan de los mapas.

items.subject: A folded West Australian newspaper announcing the town's abolition
items.action: lying open on a weathered wooden bench, pages lifted slightly by wind
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction down onto the front page headline
items.setting: Veranda of a remote Pilbara roadhouse, 2007, red dust on the boards
items.color_palette: Newsprint grey and black, weathered timber brown, red dust, soft ochre
items.props_detail: A coffee-stained enamel mug weighing down the corner of the paper
items.lighting: soft warm afternoon light under the veranda roof
items.mood: Quiet veranda, wind flicking the page, dust settling on the print
items.narration_anchor: El gobierno de Australia Occidental habla de «el fin de un período oscuro en la historia de nuestro Estado».

items.subject: Parliament House of Western Australia
items.action: standing quiet on its hill above Perth as the 1992 session closes
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction up the broad steps to the columned facade
items.setting: Perth, Western Australia, 1992, manicured lawns and Moreton Bay figs
items.color_palette: Warm sandstone, pale limestone, deep green lawns, soft evening blue sky
items.props_detail: A single parked 1980s government sedan at the foot of the steps
items.lighting: soft golden-hour light on the stone facade
items.mood: Calm stillness, long shadows across empty steps, closed doors in warm light
items.narration_anchor: Quince años antes, en mil novecientos noventa y dos, una investigación parlamentaria había recomendado limpiar los relaves. El gobierno rechazó esas recomendaciones.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings heaped in Wittenoom Gorge
items.action: spilling down the gorge slopes from the old mine site, left exactly where mining dumped them
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction along the gorge floor toward the dumps
items.setting: Wittenoom Gorge, Hamersley Range, banded red rock walls and white-trunked gums
items.color_palette: Deep red ironstone, ochre, grey-blue tailings, pale gum bark, dusty blue sky
items.props_detail: A rusted ore chute jutting from the rock above the dump
items.lighting: soft afternoon light raking across the gorge walls
items.mood: Silent gorge, still air, grey-blue mounds glowing faintly against red stone
items.narration_anchor: «La minería en los desfiladeros ha dejado una contaminación que solo puede describirse como vergonzosa, incluso para los estándares de la época», dijo Larry Graham.

items.subject: blue asbestos tailings washed downstream
items.action: settled among river stones and carried by seasonal floods into the creek bed
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction downstream along the creek toward the open floodplain
items.setting: Dry creek bed below the gorge, river gums, Fortescue floodplain beyond
items.color_palette: Red stones, pale sand, grey-blue silt, olive gum leaves, soft sky blue
items.props_detail: A shallow pool with a grey-blue film of sediment at its edge
items.lighting: soft warm late-afternoon light, reflections on still water
items.mood: Calm water, gentle light, quiet spread of sediment reaching outward
items.narration_anchor: «Tenemos el deber de impedir una mayor dispersión de los relaves de asbesto», dijo Mark Nevill, por los residentes, por los visitantes, por las generaciones futuras.

items.subject: A typed government memo lying on an office desk
items.action: resting under a lamp beside a closed cost report, its recommendation already decided
items.gaze_interaction: focal direction down onto the memo and the costing tables
items.setting: Sterile state government office in Perth, 2016, window onto city towers
items.color_palette: Off-white paper, grey laminate desk, muted navy folder, soft city blue
items.props_detail: A thick bound cost-estimate report closed beside the memo
items.lighting: soft overcast daylight from the office window
items.mood: Orderly silence, flat even light, paper squared neatly on an empty desk
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil dieciséis, los documentos dicen por qué los relaves siguen donde están: no porque no se pueda, sino por lo que cuesta.

items.subject: An elderly Banjima Aboriginal man around 70, gaunt, frail build, faded work shirt and akubra hat, bearing the signs of illness
items.action: standing at a permanent barricade while wind carries blue asbestos tailings dust past the fence across the open plain
items.gaze_interaction: seen from behind, head turned toward the drifting dust and his Country beyond
items.setting: Edge of the abolished Wittenoom zone, 2023, barricade fence across a red gravel road, Hamersley Range beyond
items.color_palette: Red earth, ochre, weathered grey steel, faint blue haze of dust, warm golden sky
items.props_detail: A rusted steel barricade gate across the empty road
items.lighting: soft golden hour, low warm sun backlighting the dust
items.mood: Wide open land under warm light, a lone frail figure upright, dust drifting freely past the fence
items.narration_anchor: En dos mil veintitrés, los estudios del Estado sobre hasta dónde llega la contaminación ya estaban desactualizados. Borraron el nombre del mapa. El polvo no leía mapas.
